environment.description: Service deployed behind Cloudflare Enterprise with the following configuration: (1) Cloudflare Managed Transform 'Add security headers' enabled which injects response header `Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'nonce-{random}' 'strict-dynamic'; object-src 'none'` on all text/html responses, stripping any existing CSP and preventing inline script execution on the /dashboard page. (2) Cloudflare WebSocket rate limiting rule configured at 20 messages/second per IP with 60-second ban on violation. Note: The WebSocket /ws endpoint itself remains accessible for legitimate API consumers. The timing data is still returned in WebSocket frames for backward compatibility with native mobile clients that parse JSON responses directly.

config.csp_injection: Managed Transform adds strict CSP with nonce requirement to all HTML responses
config.rate_limiting: 20 WebSocket messages/second per source IP, 60s ban on exceed
